description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and various services for a WebRTC call scenario.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema defining a function for LLM to call, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools available to the LLM, including standard tools like weather fetcher.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns in the conversation to determine turn boundaries.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame used to trigger LLM run in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executes the pipeline, managing its lifecycle.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object holding messages and tools for the LLM conversation.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pair of aggregators for user and assistant in the LLM context.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user aggregator, including turn strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Strategies for handling user turns, including stop strategies.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when a user turn has ended.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data via a callback.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creating transport and starting the pipeline.
